# cosmoner_bucket (Resource)

An S3-compatible object storage bucket. **Billed from creation** by tier, plus metered overage and, with `cdn_enabled`, metered CDN traffic.

The bucket is ready when the API answers, and `apply` waits for it to report `ACTIVE`, up to `timeouts.create`. A create the API refuses leaves nothing behind.

`tier`, `public_access`, `public_paths`, `cors_rules` and `cdn_enabled` change in place; a tier change or turning the CDN on is invoiced immediately. The API cannot change `versioning`, so changing it replaces the bucket **and deletes every object in it**.

Access keys are managed separately. Needs `object-storage:read` and `object-storage:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cosmoner_bucket" "assets" {
  name          = "assets"
  region        = "eu-north-1"
  tier          = "GROWTH"
  public_access = true
  public_paths  = ["images/", "downloads/"]
  cdn_enabled   = true

  cors_rules = [{
    allowed_origins = ["https://example.com"]
    allowed_methods = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    max_age_seconds = 3600
  }]
}

output "assets_cdn" {
  value = cosmoner_bucket.assets.cdn_domain
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name, unique in the project: 3 to 33 lowercase letters, digits and inner hyphens.
- `region` (String) Region to create the bucket in, e.g. `eu-north-1`.

### Optional

- `cdn_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the metered CDN add-on serves the bucket. Defaults to `false`. Needs `public_access`.
- `cors_rules` (Attributes List) CORS rules for browser access. Empty, the default, allows no cross-origin requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cors_rules))
- `project_id` (String) Project the resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing it replaces the resource.
- `public_access` (Boolean) Whether objects are publicly readable. Defaults to `false`.
- `public_paths` (Set of String) Folders that public reads and the CDN serve, each ending in `/`, e.g. `images/`. Empty, the default, covers the whole bucket. Up to 10.
- `tier` (String) Plan: `STARTER` (the default), `GROWTH`, `SCALE` or `ENTERPRISE`. The API refuses a downgrade below current usage.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `versioning` (Boolean) Whether object versioning is on. Defaults to `false`. Changing it replaces the bucket and deletes its objects.

### Read-Only

- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the bucket on the S3-compatible endpoint, which clients address.
- `cdn_domain` (String) Domain the CDN serves the bucket on while `cdn_enabled`, otherwise null.
- `created_at` (String) When the bucket was created, as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `endpoint` (String) S3-compatible endpoint URL.
- `id` (String) Bucket ID.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE` once ready.

<a id="nestedatt--cors_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cors_rules`

Required:

- `allowed_methods` (List of String) Methods allowed: `GET`, `PUT`, `POST`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`.
- `allowed_origins` (List of String) Origins allowed to make requests; `*` allows any.

Optional:

- `allowed_headers` (List of String) Request headers allowed. Defaults to none.
- `expose_headers` (List of String) Response headers browsers may read. Defaults to none.
- `max_age_seconds` (Number) How long browsers may cache the preflight response, up to 86400.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) How long to wait for the bucket to become active. Defaults to `10m`.
- `delete` (String) How long to wait for the bucket to be deleted. Defaults to `10m`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project_id>/<bucket_id>, or just <bucket_id> when the provider sets a project.
terraform import cosmoner_bucket.assets proj_123/clx0bucket
```
